title: The Carbon Bath — engineering and process views
selection_rule: Prefer v47f technical views. v44/v46/v47d studies included only when the mechanism carried into v47f (stair box, slot lock, teak treads, L-brackets, shower pan, leg posts).
image_settings: webp quality 90, method 6; max 1600px long edge; never upscaled; backgrounds left as in the source.

assets.caption: Top-down floor plan: teak deck, sink, toilet cabinet, sliding door wall and four landing legs.
assets.notes: v44 review 01_floor_plan_black_under_teak.png. Layout carried into v47f. Not upscaled (source 960×650).

assets.caption: Shower-pan section: continuous FRP pan falling to one drain, with molded ribs under the teak.
assets.notes: v47 review pan_section_v47d.png. The continuous all-sides drain pan carried into v47f. Source 1470×682, not upscaled.

assets.caption: Stowed stair-box layout, plan and side: treads, rails and slides nested in the box.
assets.notes: v44 review 46a_stowed_layout.png, labeled v46c. Box 25.30 × 20.78 × 1.75 in matches Parts List v47f, so this layout carried through.

assets.caption: Stair engineering study: deploy sequence, side elevation and packing check against the hitch.
assets.notes: v44 review 22_stair_engineering_study.png (v44 fix15). Mechanism (box stow, slide, tilt, tread lock) carried into v47f. Some dimension callouts on the sheet are from v44 and are not restated as current specs.

assets.caption: Stair mechanism study: stowed in the box, telescoped to the rim, then tilted and locked.
assets.notes: v44 review 20_stair_telescope_study.png. Teak treads, stair box and telescope-then-tilt sequence carried into v47f.

assets.caption: Tread slot-pivot lock schematic, plus the telescope side push-button.
assets.notes: v44 review 23_stair_slot_lock_schematic.png. Study of the stair lock. Source 2096×1552.

assets.caption: Side cutaway of the stowed stair box: nested teak treads and rails in the 1.75 in box.
assets.notes: v44 review 41b_side_section_centerline.png. Labeled box L 25.30 in and H 1.75 in, which match Parts List v47f.

assets.caption: Stair box hung from the floor plate on four welded L-brackets.
assets.notes: v44 review 34a_box_hung_welded_L_underside34.png (labeled v44b). Bracket hang method carried into v47f (Parts List: Stair Box Bracket ×4). Source 1000×716, not upscaled.

assets.caption: Stair-box L-bracket close-up: fillet weld to the plate and side-accessible bolts into the box wall.
Section through the bracket bolt line: weld to the plate, rivnut in the box wall, bolt clear of the stair slide path.
Stair-tread nose: underside chamfer with an LED slot, and a section through the nose.
assets.notes: v44 review 48b_tread_nose_chamfer_led_underside.png. Chamfered, lit tread nose carried into v47f. Source 1200×1400, not upscaled.

assets.caption: Packed underside, current model: landing-leg posts and the stair box under the floor plate.
assets.notes: v47 review v47f_foot_post_closeup.png. Current v47f. Source 1200×800, not upscaled.
